Meera Iyer
Senior Software Engineer | Python | Bengaluru

SUMMARY
Backend engineer with 8 years of Python experience building high-traffic REST APIs and LLM-powered services on Azure.

EXPERIENCE
Senior Software Engineer, Contoso Health | Jan 2022 - Present
- Lead a team of 4 engineers building the patient-scheduling platform with FastAPI and PostgreSQL, serving 2M+ requests/day.
- Designed REST APIs consumed by 3 mobile and 2 web clients; cut p95 latency from 900 ms to 180 ms by adding Redis caching and query tuning.
- Built a clinical-notes summarisation service with LangChain and Azure OpenAI, reducing manual review time by 40%.
- Containerised 12 services with Docker and migrated them to Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) with Helm.

Software Engineer, Fabrikam Logistics | Jun 2019 - Dec 2021
- Built shipment-tracking REST APIs in Django REST Framework backed by PostgreSQL.
- Wrote the CI/CD pipeline in GitHub Actions; raised test coverage from 35% to 85% with pytest.

Junior Python Developer, Northwind Traders | Jul 2018 - May 2019
- Automated inventory reports with Python and SQL.

SKILLS
Python, FastAPI, Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, REST APIs, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes (AKS), LangChain, Azure OpenAI, GitHub Actions, pytest

EDUCATION
B.Tech in Computer Science, 2018

CERTIFICATIONS
Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204)
